'''Ahrntim the Blighted''' is a monster that can be found in [[Shattered Worlds]] on a boss world. Every fifth world that a player enters has a chance of spawning this boss after a certain percentage of monsters are killed. He is a copy of [[Ahrim the Blighted]].
